title: Signal Locked
style: Epic hip-hop storytelling with cinematic anthem lift, mid-tempo swung drums and a grounded half-time pulse; verse rides sparse kick, sub, and tense keys, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and vocal stacks, chorus hits with world percussion, brass swells, and gang chants. Lead vocal is close-mic and urgent with doubled hooks, ad-lib throws, and spoken low intros. Ear candy includes reverse risers, impact booms, and chime flickers between lines. Bright, huge, and polished with wide cinematic depth., light, rapid, bright, hip-hop, clean, rhythmic, world, low

Signal locked.
